name: Nanami
source:
Nanami is one of the new androids of the 7th generation of robots bought by [url=https://vndb.org/c62019]Suguru[/url] and produced by a major robotics company, she is shy and very lovely. She was created in order to answer all kinds of requests (sexual option included) and her model has a customizable personality option (the "Yandere option" is also strongly discouraged by the manufacturer). She can also adapt to the tastes and preferences of her "master" to serve him better without necessarily transforming her personality.

Nanami is - like any robot - very obedient and is very talented in everything she does and she is also able to connect to the "network" in order to collect various information when she doesn't know something. However, Nanami seems to have something more, which made her more human unlike other robots ...
